name: Zealot
headerMeta: Heroic era · Melee Infantry (Two-Handed Hammer) · special · 235 leadership · Seasonal (S24: Crown and Cross)
pitch: A transformation-based shock hammer that crushes shield units and blob formations with knockdown while alive; activating Judgment Day mid-fight is its death sentence — heal and return, never transform under pressure. The unit excels against heavy-armored and fire-weak targets but collapses against high-burst claymores and Yorkists.

veterancy.label: Top line
veterancy.body: Top-line veterancy is the common recommendation.

battleRole.positioning: Stay close enough to engage with Righteous Charge (press 1 from range, or dash from melee). X-move near fights and let enemies aggro rather than pressing V immediately — the passive Malice (counts artillery, hero kills, and incoming hits) builds faster if they come to you. {1}
battleRole.tips: Never transform mid-fight. {1} Activate Judgment Day (press 3) only outside combat to heal and reposition — the transformation locks you immobile and vulnerable. {1} Righteous Charge (1) knocks down or dashes; Zeal Whirlwind (2) slams close-range. In Inquisitor form, press 1 becomes Dies irae (partial vacuum). {1} Malice passive counts kills AND damage-taken (any amount), not just kills — test in custom vs AI to see the difference. {1} Scorpio fire enrage applied before fight stays until end of game, even after unit swap or death. {1} Transformation animation cannot be cancelled once started — commit fully. {1}

controls.notes: Righteous Charge (1) — knockdown or dash depending on range; queue skill 2 while charging. {1} Zeal Whirlwind (2) — close-range slam; in Inquisitor form, dies irae becomes a partial vacuum pull. {1} Judgment Day (3) — transformation (immobilized during animation); only activate outside fights. {1} X-move + aggro-bait better than V-spam — Malice passive counts incoming damage. {1}
